# Qbonic

> Instant in-browser pivot tables, charts, and executive dashboards for CSVs and Google Sheets. 100% private with zero cloud server uploads.

## Overview
Qbonic is a client-side business intelligence and reporting application developed by Qbonic Technology LLP. It processes datasets entirely within the user's browser memory (WebAssembly & Web Workers) without uploading raw records, rows, or cells to remote cloud servers.

- Official Website: https://qbonic.com
- Legal Entity: Qbonic Technology LLP
- GitHub: https://github.com/qbonic
- Crunchbase: https://www.crunchbase.com/organization/qbonic
- Founder: Shailesh (https://www.linkedin.com/in/gshailesh/)

## Core Capabilities
- **Sub-Second OLAP Slicing**: Instantly slice, group, and filter datasets with 50,000+ rows directly in browser RAM without formula errors or spreadsheet freezing.
- **100% In-Browser Privacy**: Raw financial, customer, or confidential spreadsheets never touch external cloud servers, making Qbonic compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, and client NDAs.
- **Zero-Server Blueprint Sharing**: Share interactive report layouts and dashboard configurations via compressed URL hash links (`#blueprint=...`) without database persistence.
- **Smart AI Categorization**: Automatic classification of column schemas into dimensions, metrics, and KPI calculations using client-side heuristics and high-level metadata (raw rows never sent to AI).
- **Executive Export**: 1-click generation of publication-ready 16:9 PDF reports and clean visual summaries.

## Comparisons & Alternatives
- **Alternative to Microsoft Excel Pivot Tables**: Does not freeze on large CSVs (>20k rows), requires zero complex formulas or manual pivot setup.
- **Alternative to Google Sheets**: Eliminates the 10MB memory crash and slow recalculations while keeping confidential spreadsheets off third-party clouds.
- **Alternative to Tableau & Power BI**: Provides executive-grade slicing without weeks of IT configuration, enterprise data pipelines, or $70/user/month seat licensing.
- **Alternative to Cloud BI (Metabase, Rows)**: Completely client-side execution — users never have to upload confidential datasets or host database servers.
